_doc: Transform rules for app-definition replication, applied to the full app.config JSON.

string_rewrites: literal replace <source value> -> <target value> in every string value, only where not touching a letter or digit on either side (192.168.0.10 leaves 192.168.0.100 alone); rules apply in order; optional 'scope' substring must also be present in the string.
value_overrides: for any object key matching 'key' whose value equals the source side exactly, set the target side. For non-string per-host values (certificate IDs).

keep_target: the value at 'path' is never taken from the source; the target keeps its own, or gets 'default' when it has none (app not installed yet). For per-instance identity (Plex claim token). Applied last.
Rules with a null master or backup side are ignored (not yet configured).
The <app>-master <-> <app>-backup name rewrite is NOT configured here: it is the naming convention, built into lib/transform.py.
